findings.title: MSPNightmare/CVEs: N-Able 0-Days
findings.summary_md: The commit history of the public CVE repository now published as MSPNightmare/CVEs records the initial N-Able 0-Days upload on November 9, the earliest dated commit for this vendor in the repository. A disclaimer commit followed later the same day. N-able's own remediation update dates the first non-responsible publication wave to November 9 and says it took hosted N-central servers offline in response.

findings.title: New N-central Exploits Work Against Patched Servers, Enable Root RCE and Windows SYSTEM Access
findings.summary_md: Early coverage of Sean Bales' 4EverAble2Shell and Agent2Shell releases reports that the proof of concepts work against N-central 2026.4.1.26 Hotfix 2. 4EverAble2Shell gives unauthenticated root code execution when the non-default Legacy API is enabled and internet exposed, while Agent2Shell uses more than ten zero-days to run commands as SYSTEM on managed Windows agents if the appliance ID is known. Previdian observed probing from 157.20.241[.]16 within hours of the PoC release, and watchTowr reported probes against builds with the Legacy API on.

findings.title: MSPNightmare/CVEs: Added Agent2Shell and 4EverAble2Shell
findings.summary_md: This commit adds the Agent2Shell and 4EverAble2Shell material to the researcher's public N-central exploit repository, three days after the first N-Able 0-Days upload. A follow-up commit the same morning is titled Legacy API Update. The repository history later records a bulk publication of 24 CVEs on November 16.

findings.title: New N-able 4EverAble2Shell zero-day exploited hours after PoC released
findings.summary_md: BleepingComputer reports active exploitation of 4EverAble2Shell hours after the PoC appeared, with researchers counting at least 21 affected systems and 19 of them already running N-able's latest security update. The chain combines Apache Axis CVE-2026-90436 with an N-central privilege escalation for root command execution and needs the Legacy API feature enabled. Agent2Shell is described as SYSTEM-level execution on managed Windows devices, and N-able said it had seen no compromise from the new flaws while researchers reported successful attacks against production servers.

findings.title: N-able Patches 17 N-central Flaws as Attackers Exploit Earlier Bugs to Deploy Crypto Miners
findings.summary_md: This report records early exploitation telemetry for 4EverAble2Shell, with Previdian tracking the chain as VULN-2026-0009 and describing root command execution through unsafe class instantiation in bundled Apache Axis during SOAP fault processing. Huntback found an XMRig Monero miner on 21 N-central servers, 19 of which were already on Hotfix 2, with hosts concentrated in the United States, South Africa, Canada, the United Kingdom, Germany, France and Sweden. N-able later shared indicators including 157.20.241[.]16:8080/jup.sh, xvgz, xmrig.tgz and outbound traffic on ports 8080 and 19202 to 19418, plus 139.99.69[.]109:10128 and 79.76.51[.]56:39100.

findings.title: N-able Vulnerability Remediation Update
findings.summary_md: N-able's remediation update says it has been responding since November 9 to zero-days that were not responsibly disclosed, prioritising by severity and exploitability. It dates the second publication wave to November 12 and groups those issues into Legacy API abuse and Agent Impersonation, noting that hosted servers were taken offline before Hotfix 2 and then brought back. The November 16 update lists the 17 CVEs fixed in HF3, says the Legacy API is permanently removed, and records that direct remote control and the Intune integration remain blocked.

findings.title: N-central 2026.4 HF3 Release Notes
findings.summary_md: N-able's HF3 release notes give build number 2026.4.1.39 and list all 17 CVEs fixed, from CVE-2026-129271 through CVE-2026-129287. The update adds authentication and permission checks, hardens Agent, Probe and appliance communication, and permanently blocks legacy APIs by removing their configuration option. Devices now need an SMBIOS ID or machine ID to connect, and a new Inactive Assets tab under Configuration > Asset Discovery > Discovered Assets lists inactive Agents. Known issues are that remote control other than Take Control is disabled and the Intune integration is blocked.

findings.title: N-able Patches 17 N-central Flaws as Attackers Exploit Earlier Bugs to Deploy Crypto Miners
findings.summary_md: This HF3 report lists all 17 CVEs and notes that legacy API configuration has been completely removed. It says 4EverAble2Shell has come under active exploitation with cryptocurrency miners deployed, and links the earlier chain to the Legacy API mode being enabled. The report also notes that researcher Sean Bales published details for 24 CVEs, stating that the issues are patched and should not work on the latest patch level.
